scope: Focused response classification observations plus production wire/crypto execution; no whole-file or whole-CTAP approval
observations: ctap_process_cbor publishes successful ordinary output as a memory source only above APDU_BUFFER_SIZE=256.
Successful prepared MakeCredential publishes its segmented response source; U2F REGISTER always publishes its prefix/certificate/signature source.
CTAPHID_Execute_Msg applies Le only to apdu_source. Its no-source fallback sends rapdu.len+2 directly; an81-byte getKeyAgreement with Le1 reproduces the distinction.
Source output still streams the complete remainder if it fits Le; otherwise APDU output_source caps at250. Generic ISO buffered output obeys Le with256-byte capacity.

C credential_id is70 bytes; Rust uses34-byte IDs. The dynamic tests derive exact-size test user fields independently per format and verify each response cryptographically; they are not equal-byte comparisons.
No new source-review units are approved by these focused function observations. Negative/short file reads, broad close/cancellation schedules and physical/resource acceptance remain open.
